protocol.title: Cross-sectional options implied-volatility surface basis (BTC-vs-ETH relative near-ATM IV / skew) -> subsequent relative *direction* (BTC-minus-ETH forward signed return spread): wrapper-free Spearman rank information coefficient (predictiveness) falsification on the real on-disk three-way captures
protocol.extends: EVAL-77 (same cross-sectional BTC-vs-ETH surface basis and aligned common-bar reconstruction, reused verbatim) and EVAL-71 (surface bars + expanding z-score) but a DISTINCT target: the forward relative *direction* (signed return spread), not the relative RV *magnitude*; and EVAL-81 (order-flow -> own signed return) is single-asset order-flow, not the cross-sectional surface; no new acquisition
protocol.supersedes: nothing — this is the *directional* complement to EVAL-77 (relative-vol predictiveness) and EVAL-80 (relative-vol traded form, delta-hedged). It makes a predictiveness claim only, no traded-form / monetization claim

cross_section.target: y_k = mean_logret[BTC](k+1..k+H) - mean_logret[ETH](k+1..k+H) (forward relative direction / signed return spread)

protocol.signal: causal per-bar near-ATM implied-vol surface (EVAL-71 build_surface_bars) for BTC and ETH: atm_iv = amount-weighted mean iv of near-ATM trades; skew = mean(put iv) - mean(call iv); the relative series (ETH - BTC) is forward-filled then expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e61.expanding_zscore via EVAL-77)
protocol.target_detail: forward relative direction = mean per-bar log-return of BTC minus that of ETH over the next H perp bars, computed per underlying on the common aligned bar grid (strictly after the decision at bar k)
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(rel_z_k, y_k) over the common aligned bar-ends (H1: IC > 0, ETH richness predicts BTC outperforms ETH — relative-value directional mean reversion)

stats.permutation: directional (H1: IC>0), shuffle the relative-return spread

protocol.go_bar: GO only if at least one config (surface signal x bar grid x horizon) has Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, at least min_usable_pairs_per_config usable pairs, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

floor.note: EVAL-88 consumes both underlyings' trade-tape IV surfaces and both perp series. It composes the sealed EVAL-71 surface floor (applied to BOTH BTC and ETH, reused verbatim, neither weakened) with a cross-sectional alignment floor (>= min_aligned_common_bars bar-ends where both underlyings carry a causal near-ATM IV on the coarsest grid). This is NOT the EVAL-64 options-surface snapshot floor, which governs the EVAL-67/68/69 ladder and is untouched here.
